summary: Iteration 24 verified the new PATCH /api/meetings/{id} edit flow, expanded DELETE cancel flow, WhatsApp outbox side-effects (meeting_updated / meeting_cancelled), in-app notifications, and the frontend edit dialog UI. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_meeting_edit_cancel.py — 15/15 PASS. Covers: organizer PATCH (title+time+attendees → 200 with updated_at/updated_by), 403 for non-organizer/non-admin, super_admin & HR can PATCH any meeting, PATCH blocked on cancelled (400), bad time ordering (400), room conflict detection on PATCH (409), DELETE sets status/cancelled_at/cancelled_by + idempotent re-delete, in-app meeting_updated/meeting_cancelled notifications inserted per attendee for confirmed meetings, suppression verified for pending meetings (no notification rows, no outbox rows), and whatsapp_outbox rows written for each attendee on PATCH/DELETE of confirmed meetings. Frontend: Alex logged in → /admin/meetings → pencil edit icons visible on every scheduled card (data-testid='edit-meeting-{id}'), opening the dialog yields data-testid='edit-meeting-dialog' pre-filled with the meeting title, submit button text is exactly 'Save changes', clicking it triggered PATCH and showed toast 'Meeting updated — participants notified', card re-rendered with the edited title. Cancelled past meetings do NOT show the edit/cancel icon cluster — confirmed in the Past section.

issues: Radix a11y warning persists: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add <DialogDescription> to NewMeetingDialog (non-blocking).

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y: add DialogDescription to NewMeetingDialog so Radix stops warning in both create and edit modes.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/meetings.py PATCH correctly re-runs _has_conflict with exclude_meeting_id — good. Note: approval_status is NOT re-evaluated when a short meeting is patched into a > 120-minute window (duration_minutes is recomputed but approval_status stays 'auto_approved'). Consider re-running the needs_approval check on PATCH so a 30-minute confirmed meeting that is lengthened to 3 hours still falls back to 'pending' (currently it stays confirmed and would notify everyone without HR approval).

On attendee_user_ids PATCH: added-attendees get a 'meeting_updated' notification but NOT the original invite email/WA. If someone is added mid-cycle they get only the 'meeting_updated' template (not meeting_scheduled). That is probably fine but worth confirming with product.

DELETE cancel notification body uses user['name'] (the actor), while the WA template uses created_by_name as organizer_name. If a super_admin cancels on behalf of someone, the in-app body says 'cancelled by Admin Name' but the WA says 'from Organizer Name' — slight inconsistency; harmless but confusing in audits.
whatsapp_service DEFAULT_TEMPLATES / DEFAULT_EVENTS_ENABLED additions for meeting_updated and meeting_cancelled are correct and consistent with the shared _notify_meeting_change helper.
